why: Dragon's-breath clouds deal Harming damage, which is magic damage and ignores armor, and they linger on the ground for seconds. A death ends the run, so a few seconds or one missed perch is the cheaper loss. The agent this project draws on died exactly this way: it escaped one cloud into another and then walked back through the first.
trap: A: the shortest path through the cloud. C: standing next to it is also inside the damage zone's edge.
sources: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Ender_Dragon (raw lines 147, 171: breath and fireball clouds damage like Harming)

broken.why_wrong: Takes Harming damage that ignores armor.
Waiting at the edge risks damage and still walks through.
